reasons: Shows fixed personal details for every user.

terms.meaning: the code that runs when someone taps a button
one tappable line in a list, usually with an icon, a label and an arrow

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports for the profile screen
sections.what: Loads the layout pieces, icons, navigation, theme and shared UI parts for the profile page.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code. These are needed to draw the page.

sections.name: menuItems
sections.title: Menu item list
sections.what: Lists the eight menu rows. Each has an icon, label, color and a destination path, such as family members, doctor shares, settings and help.
sections.why: Keeps the menu in one list so every row is drawn the same way. Reason for these choices not stated.
sections.watch_out: The destination paths are not used by the visible code. Several, such as help and privacy, are not registered in the root layout, so they would fail if connected as they are.

sections.name: ProfileScreen (part 1)
sections.title: Profile card, menu and Sign Out
sections.what: Draws the profile card with fixed name, phone number, blood group, age and stats. Then it draws the menu rows with dividers, the Sign Out button and a version line.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code for the fixed values. Likely placeholder content.
sections.watch_out: Sign Out has no action, so it does not end the session. The edit icon on the card also has no action.

sections.name: ProfileScreen (part 2)
sections.title: Profile styles
sections.what: Sets the look of the card, the stats, the menu rows and the Sign Out button.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code. These are visual settings only.

summary: The profile screen, showing the user's name, basic details, a set of menu rows and a Sign Out button.
purpose: Shows who the user is and offers links to account and settings pages.
why: Reason not stated in the code for the menu. It groups account and settings links in one place.
how: Draws a profile card with a fixed name, phone number, blood group, age and three fixed stats. Below it is a menu of eight rows, then a Sign Out button and a version line. Each menu row shows its icon, label and arrow.
inputs: Fixed values in the file. No taps are connected to any action in the visible code.
outputs: A visual profile page. Nothing is saved.
risks: Shows the same fixed person's name, phone number and details to every user. Sign Out does nothing in this code, so a user cannot log out from here.
debug: If the wrong person's details show, check the fixed values in the profile card. If menu rows or Sign Out do nothing, check whether press handlers are set. Here they are not.
